text: THILSPH, in botany, a genus of the térdrynania filicul lofa clais. The pod is emarginated, heart-shaped, containing many feeds. There are ten species, for of them native of Britain, etc. the compoffre, or mihrskate; the arveffe, or treated-mullard is the perfeitaum, or perisholate treated-muillard, the fratum, or perennial multithread-muillard; the monuments, or nonnumeral nulliridate-muillard; and the burfa palforta, or thepherd's ports.

parsed.modern: THILSPH, in botany, a genus of the tetradynamia filicula class. The pod is emarginated, heart-shaped, containing many seeds. There are ten species, four of them native of Britain, etc. the campetre, or mithridate; the arvefe, or treacle-mulard is the perfoliatum, or perisholate treacle-mulard, the fratum, or perennial multithread-mulard; the montanum, or nonnumeral nulliridate-mulard; and the bursa pastoris, or the shepherd's purse.
